top_stories.title: US Treasury secretary confirms plans for $250 bill featuring Trump’s face | Donald Trump News | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: **US Secretary of the Treasury Scott Bessent** confirmed plans for a new $250 bill featuring President Donald Trump's face, pending legislation that would allow current and former presidents to appear on US currency.  The proposed design, which is in anticipation of a change in law, was created by **Treasurer Brandon Beach**, a Trump appointee, with the intention of marking the 250th anniversary of the Declaration of Independence. The Treasury Department has not yet responded to requests for comment.

top_stories.title: Ashok Leyland shares fall 2% after Q4 results. Do Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley see any upside? - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Ashok Leyland's** fourth quarter revenue grew over 17% year-on-year to Rs 17,417 crore.  Analysts at **Goldman Sachs**, **Morgan Stanley**, and **Motilal Oswal** maintained their ratings on the company with varying price targets.  While near-term demand is expected to be driven by mining, infrastructure tippers, and tractor trailers, analysts caution against short-term margin pressure due to commodity inflation and rising diesel prices.

top_stories.title: Italy Heatwave: Italy on red alert as France, Portugal beat hottest May day record - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Italy**, **Portugal**, and **France** issued warnings as a heatwave brought record-breaking temperatures to Europe.  The mercury peaked at 40.3C in **Portugal**, surpassing the previous record of 40C from May 2001, while **Britain** and **France** reported their hottest-ever May days. The heatwave has caused hospitalisations in **Portugal** and deaths attributed to drowning accidents in both **Britain** and **France**.  The **European meteorological agency** warned that the heatwave is likely to last into early June.

top_stories.title: HDFC Bank shares fall 5% in two sessions; lender responds to recent Rs 45 crore differential payment report - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: **HDFC Bank** issued a statement clarifying that its internal audit function routinely reviews practices and addresses any observations. The bank maintains sound financial practices and robust internal controls, stating it remains committed to corporate governance and regulatory compliance.  The report in **The Indian Express** stated that an internal audit flagged payments made to the Maharashtra State Road Development Corporation (MSRDC) just days before former chairman Atanu Chakraborty resigned on March 18th. The bank's Chief Marketing Officer, Ravi Santhanam, acknowledged the marketing department facilitated a "camouflage" of interest reimbursement as marketing spend during senior-level discussions.  The Vigilance probe report was sent to two top committees: the Audit Committee and the Nomination and Remuneration Committee.

top_stories.title: Internal bickering, resignations and public anger, Trinamool battling on multiple fronts - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Trinamool Congress** continues to face internal turmoil following its electoral defeat in West Bengal.  Senior MPs **Kakoli Ghosh Dastidar** and **Kalyan Banerjee** engaged in a public dispute, while senior MP **Sougata Roy** faced protests and alleged attacks from BJP supporters.  The party also saw the arrest of **Baduria municipality chairperson Dipankar Bhattacharya**, who was allegedly found with over ₹2.24 crore hidden in a jute field.  Former Rajya Sabha MP **Santanu Sen** resigned, criticizing the party's handling of the RG Kar rape and murder case.  **Mamata Banerjee** shared a cryptic poem on social media, while **Kunal Ghosh** urged party leaders to focus on internal solutions.

top_stories.title: A 2,000-year-old stone found in Karnak temple reveals a Roman emperor hidden in the form of an Egyptian pharaoh | World News - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Egypt’s** Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities, in collaboration with an **Egyptian-French** archaeological team, has uncovered hidden layers beneath the northern wall gate associated with Ramses III at the Karnak temples. The project revealed reused stones from earlier dynasties, suggesting that the gate was built using material from older monuments, creating a kind of architectural archive.  The excavations also unearthed construction phases spanning multiple periods, including Roman and Byzantine eras, indicating a dynamic religious landscape that evolved over time. A sandstone stela depicting Emperor Tiberius in traditional pharaonic style, found near the gate, suggests how Roman authority was integrated into existing religious systems.

top_stories.title: Blue Origin’s New Glenn rocket explodes on launchpad in Florida | Science and Technology News | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Blue Origin’s** New Glenn rocket exploded on a test launchpad in Florida, the latest setback for the company's space venture. The incident occurred during a hot-fire test and caused a massive fireball that sent smoke billowing into the air. **Jeff Bezos**, founder of **Blue Origin**, stated that the cause is still unknown but personnel are safe.  **Mike Haridopolos**, US House Representative from Florida, expressed gratitude for no injuries and commended first responders.

top_stories.title: Israel, Russia added to UN blacklist on sexual violence in conflicts - World - DAWN.COM
top_stories.rephrased_article: The **United Nations** has added **Israel** and **Russia** to its annual list of groups suspected of systematic sexual violence in conflict. The report, published annually by the UN, documented incidents in Ukraine and the occupied Palestinian territories, including rape, genital mutilation, and torture against Palestinians detained by Israeli authorities.  **Israel** responded with a freeze on relations with the UN secretary-general's office until the end of his term, while **Russia** was also accused of sexual violence against prisoners of war in occupied Ukrainian territories and within Russia itself.

top_stories.title: Netanyahu says he has directed IDF to increase control of Gaza to 70%
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Benjamin Netanyahu**, the Israeli Prime Minister, announced a directive to increase Israel's control of Gaza to 70%, contradicting the ceasefire agreement reached in October 2025.  This expansion comes as Israel continues strikes on Gaza despite the truce and stalled negotiations for the implementation of the Trump-led peace plan. **Israel Defense Minister Israel Katz** stated that Israel pledged to eliminate Hamas leaders, while **National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir** and **Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich** have defended what they call a "voluntary migration" of Palestinians from Gaza, which could be considered forced displacement. At least 738 Palestinians have been killed since the ceasefire began, according to the Hamas-run health ministry.

top_stories.title: Silver drops Rs 1,500/kg, gold at Rs 1.56 lakh/10 gms as Iran war tensions weigh. Key levels to watch - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: **MCX** silver futures for July 2026 delivery fell by Rs 1,518 to Rs 2,68,018 per kg, while gold futures for June 2026 delivery dropped by Rs 609 to Rs 1,56,316 per 10 grams. **U.S.** inflation accelerated in April, prompting economists to expect the Federal Reserve to keep interest rates unchanged for a prolonged period.  **John Williams**, President of the **Federal Reserve Bank of New York**, stated that monetary policy remains appropriately positioned given the current economic outlook and predicted elevated inflation in the near term before easing later this year.
